outcome: Thromboprophylaxis practices during and following CS
Obstetricians' willingness to participate in a randomised controlled trial
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 488 currently practicing obstetricians (fellows and trainees of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists).
finding: There is considerable variation in clinical practice regarding thromboprophylaxis during and following Caesarean section among Australian and New Zealand obstetricians, who generally support a randomized controlled trial for assessment.
mod_finding: Emergency CS was associated with more frequent LMWH use compared to planned CS.
cross-section timing: The survey captured clinical practice around 2015-2016.
